dish.title: Shrimp and Grits with Smoky Garlic-Lemon Pan Sauce and Cheddar Grits
dish.description: Old-fashioned grits simmered in milk and water until creamy, finished with sharp cheddar and butter, and topped with shrimp seared with smoked paprika and cayenne, then tossed with garlic, scallions, and lemon in a buttery pan sauce.

recipe_version.title: Shrimp and Grits with Smoky Garlic-Lemon Pan Sauce and Cheddar Grits
recipe_version.description: Old-fashioned grits simmered in milk and water until creamy, finished with sharp cheddar and butter, and topped with shrimp seared with smoked paprika and cayenne, then tossed with garlic, scallions, and lemon in a buttery pan sauce.

ingredients.name: large shrimp (21-25 per lb)
ingredients.display_name: large shrimp (21-25 per lb), peeled and deveined

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.preparation: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with the smoked paprika, cayenne, black pepper, and 1/2 tsp salt. Mince the garlic, slice the scallions keeping whites and greens apart, grate the cheddar, and juice the lemon.

steps.title: Cook the grits
steps.body: Combine 3 cups water, the milk, and 1 tsp salt in a 3-quart saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high, about 7 minutes to come to a boil. Whisk in the grits in a slow stream, turn the heat to low, cover partly, and cook, whisking every 3 minutes so they do not stick, until thick and tender, about 18 minutes. Off the heat stir in the cheddar and 2 tbsp butter.

steps.title: Sear the shrimp
steps.body: During the last 8 minutes of the grits (overlap stated): heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add the shrimp in one layer and sear 2 minutes, flip, and cook 1 minute. Lower to medium, add 2 tbsp butter, the garlic, and the scallion whites and stir 1 minute. Add 1/3 cup water and the lemon juice and scrape up the browned bits until the sauce is glossy and the shrimp are opaque, about 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the grits into shallow bowls, top with the shrimp and pan sauce, and scatter the scallion greens.
